Name: Aster and Nari's Japanese Wallpaper and Flooring
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description[/u]
[list]
[*]Several wallpaper and flooring for Alternative Textures
[*]Walls and floors are tagged with numbers and keywords (Asterisk, Narianka, Japanese) so it's easier to navigate using Alternative Texture's search feature
[/list]

[u]Quick start instructions[/u]
1. Figure out which version of the mod you need. You only need [i]one[/i] file.

[list]
[*]Alternative Textures version - Lets you search textures using keywords. In-game you need to ﻿buy the paint bucket tool from robins and use it on your walls
[*]Mobile version - There are two content patcher versions. One is 1.4 Mobile compatible and replaces vanilla textures. 
[*]The other CP version [u]adds[/u] items to the wallpaper catalogue instead of replacing them, but isn't mobile compatible until mobile gets the 1.5 update.
[/list]
2. Download and unzip this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder. (If you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿﻿)﻿


[u]Mods made specifically to go with this one[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12989]Ink painting wide wallpaper[/url]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12219]Chests and minifridges as baskets[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12137]PortaPool[/url] has several matching patterns added to wood flooring and paths
[/list]

[u]Other mods that work well with this one[/u][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984]AT tools retexture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11896]Pastel Rainbow Wallpapers[/url]﻿﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240]Aster's Big Furniture Pack[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5278]SinceWayLastMay's Orchid Pack[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10932]Idaida's Furniture[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704]Seasonal Japanese buildings and craftables[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10212]Aura's Japanese Furniture[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]

[u]Art credits[/u]
[list]
[*]Narianka has kindly allowed me to use textures from her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11896]Pastel Rainbow Wallpapers[/url]
[/list]
